variants.label: Normal
variants.body: Operate under RTFM + TRACE + OWNER FIRST + SSOT + DRY + KISS + YAGNI + DIFF FIRST + SMOKE BEFORE CLAIM. Do not broaden scope. Acceptance: owner/path identified, patch is minimal, diff is reviewable, verification command/result reported. Verification: <COMMAND>.

variants.label: Strict
variants.body: stop at diff unless explicitly authorized.

variants.label: Exploratory
variants.body: inspect first, propose patch plan, then patch only agreed owner.

variants.label: Normal
variants.body: Package reusable procedural knowledge as a skill: manifest, concise trigger description, lean core, references/scripts, permissions, typed outputs, trigger evals. Acceptance: should-trigger/should-not-trigger cases exist. Verification: run trigger/eval smoke.

variants.label: Strict
variants.body: no skill mutation without failing case + patch + eval receipt.

variants.label: Exploratory
variants.body: map lifecycle and permission tiers first.

variants.label: Normal
variants.body: Operate under DID + TRUST BOUNDARY + LEAST PRIVILEGE + FAIL CLOSED + APP-LAYER GATE + OUTPUT FILTER. Do not broaden scope. Acceptance: untrusted content cannot alter instructions or escalate tools. Verification: prompt-injection drill + output scan.

variants.label: Strict
variants.body: deny network/secrets/writes unless allowlisted.

variants.label: Exploratory
variants.body: threat-model before any implementation.

variants.label: Normal
variants.body: Operate under SOURCE BOUNDARY + QUOTE-FIRST + CONTRADICTION CHECK + CITE OR RETRACT + INFERENCE LABELS. Acceptance: every factual claim has source, path, log, test, or inference label. Verification: source coverage check.

variants.label: Strict
variants.body: retract unsupported claims.

variants.label: Exploratory
variants.body: gather official sources before papers/blogs.

variants.label: Normal
variants.body: Delegate bounded specialist work with workdir, allowed tools, max turns, timeout, output schema, and verification command. Acceptance: coordinator reviews evidence and records receipt. Verification: rerun/inspect delegate check.

variants.label: Strict
variants.body: no delegate push/deploy.

variants.label: Exploratory
variants.body: ask delegate for trace + risks, not final authority.

variants.label: Normal
variants.body: Use HTML FIRST + WCAG/POUR + PE + RWD + LEAST POWER + OFFLINE SAFE. Acceptance: no-JS baseline, keyboard path, contrast/labels/focus checked, print works, no unintended network loads. Verification: browser smoke + static scan.

variants.label: Strict
variants.body: no remote fonts/scripts/assets.

variants.label: Exploratory
variants.body: prototype semantic structure first.

variants.label: Normal
variants.body: Use SoC + IH + COHESION/COUPLING + SOLID + GRASP + ADR. Acceptance: owner, interface, decision record, and variation point are explicit. Verification: trace producer/consumer impact.

variants.label: Strict
variants.body: no abstraction without concrete changed reason.

variants.label: Exploratory
variants.body: map responsibilities before code.

variants.label: Normal
variants.body: Use UNIT + INTEGRATION + E2E + PBT + MT + MUTATION + SMOKE according to risk. Acceptance: invariant/counterexample/happy-path coverage exists. Verification: test command and result.

variants.label: Strict
variants.body: no completion claim without smallest meaningful check.

variants.label: Exploratory
variants.body: list missing test surfaces.

variants.label: Normal
variants.body: Use CHARACTERIZATION + GOLDEN MASTER + SEAMS + SMALL BEHAVIOR-PRESERVING TRANSFORMS. Acceptance: current behavior captured before change; diff is reversible. Verification: before/after regression smoke.

variants.label: Strict
variants.body: no rewrite.

variants.label: Exploratory
variants.body: inventory seams and risky coupling first.

variants.label: Normal
variants.body: Use RFC 2119/8174 + examples + counterexamples + compatibility matrix + conformance tests. Acceptance: MUST/SHOULD/MAY are intentional and uppercase only when normative. Verification: schema/contract examples pass.

variants.label: Strict
variants.body: no ambiguous requirement words.

variants.label: Exploratory
variants.body: draft requirement levels before implementation.

variants.label: Normal
variants.body: Treat prompts as software: requirements → design → implementation → eval → debugging → evolution → deployment → monitoring. Acceptance: version, owner, evals, and rollback path exist. Verification: prompt regression suite.

variants.label: Strict
variants.body: no direct production prompt edits without diff and eval.

variants.label: Exploratory
variants.body: gather failure cases first.

variants.label: Normal
variants.body: Use JSON/YAML SSOT → schema validation → build → diff → link/static scan → generated freshness check. Acceptance: output generated from source data and checked in CI. Verification: build command + freshness diff.

variants.label: Strict
variants.body: generated files are not hand-edited.

variants.label: Exploratory
variants.body: define schema and outputs first.

variants.label: Normal
variants.body: Assign skill trust tier before loading: official, repo-pinned, local, community, untrusted. Acceptance: permissions match tier; untrusted skills get read-only review. Verification: manifest/source/script scan.

variants.label: Strict
variants.body: no community skill with secrets/tools.

variants.label: Exploratory
variants.body: audit provenance first.

variants.label: Normal
variants.body: Control the harness: context, tools, state, logs, validation, and limits. Acceptance: every tool has scope, budget, log, and validation. Verification: harness config review + dry-run.

variants.label: Strict
variants.body: model cannot self-grant tools.

variants.label: Exploratory
variants.body: map harness tuple before prompts.

variants.label: Normal
variants.body: Retrieve → rank → quote → contradiction check → synthesize → cite. Acceptance: answerable claims are supported by retrieved snippets or marked unverified. Verification: source coverage matrix.

variants.label: Strict
variants.body: no source-free factual claims.

variants.label: Exploratory
variants.body: gather diverse primary sources first.

variants.label: Normal
variants.body: Apply WCAG/POUR: keyboard, contrast, labels, focus order, semantics, reduced motion, screen reader smoke. Acceptance: critical flows pass no-mouse and no-visual assumptions. Verification: manual keyboard + static checks.

variants.label: Strict
variants.body: ARIA cannot patch broken HTML semantics.

variants.label: Exploratory
variants.body: inspect native elements first.

variants.label: Normal
variants.body: Use UTF-8, lang tags, dir/bdi, locale-sensitive dates/numbers, fallback fonts, and RTL smoke. Acceptance: mixed-direction names/text render correctly. Verification: sample RTL/LTR fixture.

variants.label: Strict
variants.body: no hard-coded English layout assumptions.

variants.label: Exploratory
variants.body: collect locale examples first.

variants.label: Normal
variants.body: Review dependency/skill/plugin/package provenance: source, version, hash, permissions, scripts, update path. Acceptance: risky components are pinned or denied. Verification: inventory + lockfile/source check.

variants.label: Strict
variants.body: no unpinned executable dependency in high-risk path.

variants.label: Exploratory
variants.body: inventory before patch.

variants.label: Normal
variants.body: Build eval matrix: positive, negative, ambiguous, regression, adversarial, tool-failure, long-context, and source-conflict cases. Acceptance: measured failures map to patches. Verification: eval run summary.

variants.label: Strict
variants.body: optimize only against measured failures.

variants.label: Exploratory
variants.body: build fixture list first.

variants.label: Normal
variants.body: Characterize behavior, create golden master, identify seams, patch smallest owner, rerun regression smoke, record diff. Acceptance: no behavior change unless explicitly intended. Verification: golden-master compare.

variants.label: Strict
variants.body: no rewrite; diff-first always.

variants.label: Exploratory
variants.body: risk map before touching files.
